verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-action capability: no multi-select, batch edit, or batch API endpoint that acts on many conversations at once. What it does show is adjacent: per-conversation rules ('Up to 1000 rules', multi-step rules acting 'on the same conversation') and REST API/MCP access that a developer or external agent could use to loop over items one at a time under documented rate limits. Those are building blocks or related automation, not the bulk-operation capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
